messages.subject: v3 launch date - proposing Wednesday 15 April
messages.body:
Hi all,

Quick recap of where v3 stands and a date proposal:

1. Route optimization and the new dashboard are on track for feature-complete by mid-March
2. Redline's pilot is confirmed to start Monday 20 April - Bruno has it in his ops calendar
3. That gives us a launch window of the week before the pilot

I propose we launch v3 on Wednesday 15 April. That leaves a clear week for pilot onboarding support and a buffer weekend for anything ugly. Thanks!

messages.subject: RE: v3 launch date - proposing Wednesday 15 April
messages.body:
Concern: 15 April is tight. We also committed to the Corvid hosting migration in March, so launch prep and infrastructure work overlap in the same month. If feature-complete slips even two weeks, the 15th disappears entirely. I'm not saying no - I'm saying we should treat the 15th as ambitious, not promised.

My take: hold the 15th, but nobody sells a hard date to customers until we clear feature-complete in March.

Cheers, Dev

messages.subject: RE: v3 launch date - proposing Wednesday 15 April
messages.body: Confirmed: v3 launches Wednesday 15 April. Chloe, the date is yours to build the campaign on - I'll send you the messaging brief by Friday. Dev, understood on the Corvid work going first; I've moved the RC freeze earlier in the plan accordingly. Thanks!
